title.text: Google推出Gemini agent，企业员工多了个AI同事账号

oneline.text: 代理有自己的Workspace账号和邮箱，可接MCP服务器。

bullets.v: Google宣布面向工作的通用Gemini agent。
代理拿到独立Workspace账号、邮箱、日历和Drive。
可在Cloud Billing设硬性花费上限，触发后代理暂停。

news.sourceQuote: The agent receives its own Workspace account, including an email address, calendar, Drive, and presence in your company directory.

sourceEvidence.claim: Google发布面向工作的通用Gemini agent。
sourceEvidence.quote: today we are excited to announce the Gemini agent: your new single, universal agent for work.

sourceEvidence.claim: 代理拥有独立Workspace账号。
sourceEvidence.quote: The agent receives its own Workspace account, including an email address, calendar, Drive, and presence in your company directory.

sourceEvidence.claim: 可设置项目级硬性花费上限。
sourceEvidence.quote: Real-time spend caps: You can set a hard limit on a project's AI spend in the Cloud Billing Console, and Gemini enforces it.

sourceEvidence.claim: 先面向企业，之后再推向个人用户。
sourceEvidence.quote: Google will initially focus on bringing the agent to businesses before later rolling it out to consumers.

sourceEvidence.claim: 操作归于代理名下
sourceEvidence.quote: In addition, every action Gemini takes is written to an audit trail and attributed to the agent rather than to a person.

sourceEvidence.claim: 同事代理只见分享内容
sourceEvidence.quote: A coworker agent acts under its own identity rather than yours, and it sees only what you share with it.

sourceEvidence.claim: 花费上限触发暂停
sourceEvidence.quote: Gemini monitors token usage and sandbox costs, and if a spend cap is triggered, that project's agent pauses, and you can choose to resume work with a single click in the console.

oneline.text: 选举、虚假账号、武器软件和监控条款都写得更具体。

bullets.v: 选举条款改名为Do Not Undermine Democratic Processes。
武器软件、未经同意追踪和监控条款写得更明确，相关限制此前已执行。
做营销自动化或数据抓取的团队，11月12日前对照条款自查。

news.sourceQuote: The updated policy takes effect on November 12.

sourceEvidence.claim: 新政策11月12日生效。
sourceEvidence.quote: The updated policy takes effect on November 12.

sourceEvidence.claim: 禁止用虚假账号隐藏发布者或放大内容。
sourceEvidence.quote: efforts to obscure who is behind a message or amplify content through fake accounts or posts

sourceEvidence.claim: 禁止开发或改进监控工具。
sourceEvidence.quote: We also prohibit Claude from being used to build or improve tools designed for surveillance.

sourceEvidence.claim: 新增禁止对模型持续、无必要的辱骂。
sourceEvidence.quote: We’ve added a prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward our models.

sourceEvidence.claim: 独立报道确认辱骂条款不覆盖普通抱怨、反驳、黑暗题材和模型测试。
sourceEvidence.quote: It does not apply to common versions of user frustration, pushback, dark creative themes, or model testing and research.

sourceEvidence.claim: 武器软件范围
sourceEvidence.quote: the software and components that make weapons work

sourceEvidence.claim: 辱骂条款的测试例外
sourceEvidence.quote: It does not apply to common versions of user frustration, pushback, dark creative themes, or model testing and research.

title.text: OpenAI公开719份数学稿件，验证仍未补齐

oneline.text: 约42%的主要结果有Lean形式化，其余仍待核对。

bullets.v: GitHub公开719份由内部模型产出的数学稿件。
OpenAI自己写明约42%主要结果已形式化，部分可能有问题。
数学界准则要求公开思维链和元数据，TechCrunch称仅10份附了思维链。

news.sourceQuote: The current catalogue contains 719 manuscripts organized into 372 families.

sourceEvidence.claim: 共719份稿件，分372组。
sourceEvidence.quote: The current catalogue contains 719 manuscripts organized into 372 families.

sourceEvidence.claim: 约42%主要结果已形式化，未形式化部分可能有问题。
sourceEvidence.quote: The repository has ~42% top-line results formalized.

sourceEvidence.claim: 准则要求公开模型名、提示词和思维链摘要。
sourceEvidence.quote: the AI lab should make public the name of the model, the prompts used, a (summarized) chain of thought

sourceEvidence.claim: 有论文指出Navier-Stokes结果的Lean证明与自然语言证明不对应。
sourceEvidence.quote: the formalised Lean proof does not correspond to the NL proof

sourceEvidence.claim: 仅10份稿件附带思维链。
sourceEvidence.quote: Just 10 of the 719 manuscripts included releases of the model’s chain of thought.

sourceEvidence.claim: 未形式化结果可能有问题
sourceEvidence.quote: Some of the unformalized results could have issues.

sourceEvidence.claim: 约4000问题
sourceEvidence.quote: Over the course of the evaluation, the model was posed approximately 4,000 problems.
